name: Bin Coder
aliases: Hybrid Bin Coder Utilizing VV Codes
definition: A collection of zero-order entropy coders (bins), each designed to efficiently encode a memoryless source over a specific probability range, collectively covering 0.5 ≤ p ≤ 1.0.
summary: The Bin Coder partitions bits into probability-based bins for specialized VV or Golomb encoding, avoiding arithmetic coding overhead and output interleaving to efficiently compress skewed bit streams.
